name: Cursor
verdict: New buyers get Cursor inside the X Subscription from $8 a month; the docs still list a separate Pro plan at $20.
pros: Agent, cloud agents, and Bugbot from Premium up
Third-party models are available at API list price
cons: A second, older plan list is still in the docs
pricingNote: cursor.com/pricing is The X Subscription, which also includes Grok and X. The docs at cursor.com/docs/account/pricing still list legacy plans: Start ₹649/mo (India only), Pro $20/mo, Pro Plus $60/mo, Ultra $200/mo, and Teams at $40 or $120 per user. x.ai says existing Cursor plans continue and switching is optional.
